question: Which column has a sum that is a perfect square? [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dabb0b0260f240ba0328dbbdf3e9c4035901198607edda818c825e076a74519f.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Add the numbers in each column and check if the sum is a perfect square.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dabb0b0260f240ba0328dbbdf3e9c4035901198607edda818c825e076a74519f.png] 

Column A:

= 6 + 11 + 8

= 25 (Perfect square )

Column B:

= 1 + 4 + 3

= 8 (Not a perfect square)

Column C:

= 5 + 2 + 11

= 18 (Not a perfect square)

Column D:

= 8 + 4 + 1

= 13 (Not a perfect square)

So, Column A has a perfect square sum.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
